summary: Iteration 5 — aviation theme + SAP undo-last-import. Backend: 15/15 pytest passed (new endpoints sap-last-import & sap-undo-last incl. multi-batch isolation, validation, auth + iter4 regressions). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright run validated tricolor stripe, 'Welcome aboard' heading, airplane-icon login submit, login redirect, project header airline-stripe + aviation-watermark, advance-stage-btn airplane variant, SAP revenue upload → 'Undo last import (332)' chip → confirm/undo flow → button hidden, cost SAP button present, ProjectFormModal Save Project airplane button. Test env left clean (no leftover SAP batches). 0 pageerrors / 0 uncaught console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: PASS: server.py project_sap_upload (~lines 1039-1100) attaches batch_id + import_source='sap_excel' on every inserted row and returns batch_id in the response.
PASS: project_sap_last_import (~1103-1129) gracefully short-circuits when actual row count is 0 (handles externally-deleted rows) and properly excludes already-undone logs via undone_at marker.

PASS: project_sap_undo_last (~1132-1154) is correctly idempotent — second invocation returns 404 'No SAP import to undo' (validated by tests test_undo_idempotent_404 and test_upload_then_undo_round_trip).

PASS: Multi-batch isolation verified — when batches A and B exist, undo deletes only the latest (B), and last-import then surfaces A; second undo wipes A; third returns 404. Confirms log sort by uploaded_at + filtering by undone_at.
PASS: kind validation via FastAPI Query regex returns 422 for unknown values; pid not-found returns 404; unauthenticated requests blocked (401/403).

PASS: LoginPage tricolor stripe colors are exact India tricolor (rgb(255,153,51)/white/rgb(19,136,8)); Welcome aboard h1 present; AirplaneButton renders with class 'btn-airplane' and visible AirplaneTilt svg inside .plane-icon — confirmed for login-submit, advance-stage-btn, and form-submit.

PASS: PageHeader on project detail has both 'airline-stripe' and 'aviation-watermark' classes; the watermark pseudo-elements DO NOT block clicks (advance-stage-btn was clickable; SAP buttons within the page were clickable).

PASS: GET /api/projects/{pid}/revenue uses response_model=List[RevenueLineOut] which intentionally omits import_batch_id — adjusted test to verify deletion via has_batch:false + row-count delta instead. This is by design (line 686-688) but worth documenting that the field exists on the document yet isn't surfaced via API.

MINOR: AirplaneButton special-cases type='submit' to skip onClick delay (lines 31-36) so HTML form submission isn't suppressed — good. However the .plane-icon takeoff animation only fires for non-submit clicks; verify visually if desired.
OPEN (carried from iter4): server.py is 1497 lines; SAP / Upload / Project routes should be split into routers per domain.
seed_data_creation: Tests upload SAP revenue/cost batches against seed project 'Smart Airside Gate Solution' (WSIN.000136.0001) and undo every batch they create so the env is left with has_batch:false for both kinds. Confirmed clean post-run via /sap-last-import.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_sap_iter5.py (15 tests, 6.9s runtime). rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. All five iteration-5 acceptance items (batch_id persistence, sap-last-import GET, sap-undo-last POST incl. idempotent 404, aviation UI theme, AirplaneButton on login/advance/save) are working end-to-end.
